fit: Freeze the H593 context basis. For each case form columns T(a_j,e); solve float64 SVD least squares against the full target T(dc,e), rcond=1e-10. This is a target-informed per-case oracle, not a learned coefficient predictor. Basis unchanged.
identity: Context-switch response T(dc,e)=Down(Left(dc)*Right(e)+Left(e)*Right(dc)). Quadratic-in-e term cancels exactly.
design: Compare full target, unchanged context, Euclidean context projection and response-optimal context-span oracle. Evaluate live downstream fidelity at both signs/doses across all H593 cells. Audit conditioning, coefficient norms, normal equations and direct coefficient replay.
scope: Oracle sees each full local response target and actual incoming perturbation. It minimizes local Euclidean response error only, not output KL or answer loss; success is not generalization. Counterfactual coefficient norms and conditioning are reported.
